# Final Studio Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos gives the plan no independent throne from what must truly be done;
Awtsmoos.com will rewrite complete vessels, prove each public contract, and leave no half-styled control when the wave is won.

## First code wave — visual/property architecture

Rewrite/create:
- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/styles/studio.css`
- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/styles/studio/shell.css`
- `properties.css`
- `controls.css`
- `timeline.css`
- `clips.css`
- `layers.css`
- `responsive.css`
- `interaction.css`
- `geelooy/apps/rebbe/modules/studio/ui.js`
- `modules/studio/ui/PropertiesPanelController.js`
- `modules/studio/ui/StudioResizerController.js`
- `modules/studio/ui/props/StudioFieldFactory.js`
- `modules/studio/ui/props/StudioActionFactory.js`
- rewrite `props/global.js`, `props/clip.js`, `props/fx.js`

## Second code wave — oversized live logic

After the first wave is structurally settled, fully split/rewrite:
- `modules/studio/actions.js`
- `modules/studio/interaction.js`
- `modules/studio/project.js`
with new focused submodules so all touched live source is <=120 lines.

## Tests after code completion

- Studio style/layer/mobile contract.
- Studio property safe-DOM/control contract.
- Studio public compatibility/source-size contract.
- Full Rebbe regression suite.

## Completion condition

Studio is not complete until loaded Studio CSS has no raw numeric layer war, mobile actions remain >=44px and bounded, property controls are fully styled/static and safe-DOM rendered, all touched live modules are <=120 lines, tests pass, and fresh route evidence is collected.
